purpose: MVP semantic proxy catalog for rough but readable multi-shot Seedance scene references.
rules: semanticType describes identity and expected scene meaning.
dimensions describe current physical size in meters and may diverge from the type default.
Changing semanticType must preserve custom dimensions unless the user explicitly resets size.
Person proxies use one class color across head, torso and limbs; white and dark contrast is reserved for face, facing and joint markers.
Legacy wizard is an input-only compatibility marker normalized to adult_male and is never emitted by current saves.
Road is a surface-like proxy and must not behave as a blocking collision obstacle.

seedanceValidation.description: One outdoor roadside scene: house block beside a road, two different trees, bush and rock as landmarks, adult male, adult female, child, dog, and SUV visible across three camera angles.

shots.name: wide-establishing
shots.goal: All proxies are readable as scene anchors; road direction, house position, trees, SUV, people, child, and dog remain spatially consistent.

shots.name: medium-roadside
shots.goal: Camera changes focal length and angle while retaining road/house/tree layout and character identities.

shots.name: low-dog-suv-angle
shots.goal: Foreground dog/SUV relation remains stable and background landmarks do not swap or disappear.

passCriteria: Seedance output keeps the same road, house, tree pair, rock, bush, SUV, dog, and three people across all shots.
Character semantic identities survive non-default dimensions, including an oversized child if assigned.
No shot interprets the road as a wall-like blocking object.
seedanceValidation.automationBoundary: PreVision can verify proxy metadata and multi-shot prompt/reference export deterministically; final Seedance visual consistency still requires manual review because external generation is not called in tests.
